transcript: Someone just built the world's biggest prompt library, and made it completely free and open-source. It's called prompts.chat, and it has over 10,000 prompts for writing, coding, images, video, and research, plus readymade skills and workflows for pretty much any task you guys can think of. And the best part is, you can plug the whole library straight into Claude Code just as an MCP server, so your agent will automatically pick the best prompt for whatever task you're working on, and you never have to copy paste anything again. So if you guys want to try it for yourselves, just comment prompt down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
